title: A member can top the gym's kg board with made-up sets
what: The one kg-lifted rule that feeds the gym leaderboard takes any weight and any reps a member types, with no ceiling per set. The only guard is that a day above 60,000 kg is left out, which is several times a real heavy session. A member can type a few huge sets every day and lead the gym's kg board and any kg challenge.
expected: Sets far beyond what a person can lift are not counted on the gym board (or are flagged), and the daily ceiling sits near a real hard session.
who: members in a gym with a kg board or kg challenge
fix_line: Cap what one set and one day can add to the gym board at a believable level, and show the gym owner unusual jumps

title: A shared routine file's exercise names go straight into the 'Ask your own AI' text
what: A routine file from someone else can carry exercise names of up to 120 characters of any text. Once the member logs those exercises, the names are copied as they are into the summary the member pastes into their own AI, so a sender could plant a line that steers that AI's answer. No gym AI or credits are involved and the member sees the text before sharing.
expected: Exercise names in the AI summary are plain names only (catalogue name where known, odd characters and instruction-like text removed).
fix_line: Use the catalogue name in the AI summary when there is one, and trim custom names to short plain words
